item1.q: How quickly can I have my website and system running?
item1.a: Our implementation process is optimized to be agile. Generally, after receiving all your information and approval of content and structure, we can have your Basic Package ready in approximately 1 week, and the Professional or 360 Packages in 1-2 weeks, depending on complexity and selected add-ons.

item2.a: Not at all! GoDigital Suite is a 'turnkey' solution. We handle all technical configuration, design (based on professional templates we customize with your brand) and launch. We deliver your digital ecosystem ready to use and offer basic training so you can manage it.

item3.q: What if my business grows and I need more features?
item3.a: GoDigital Suite is designed to scale with you. You can start with one package and then upgrade it, or add specific features through our Add-ons catalog at any time. Our goal is for technology to adapt to your changing needs.

item4.q: What exactly does the 'From X' price include?
item4.a: The 'From X' price is a starting point and can vary significantly depending on the payment scheme you choose when contracting. We offer flexibility with options such as one-time implementation payments, monthly payments (which can be lower if combined with an initial payment), or annual plans with additional benefits. This structure allows us to adapt the investment to your specific needs and the value that the Suite will bring you. An Aurhora Agency executive will personally accompany you to detail all options, understand your requirements and help you configure the plan and payment scheme that best fits your business during a personalized consultation.

item5.q: What type of support do you offer?
item5.a: All plans include basic technical support and a post-launch warranty period to correct any technical errors attributable to Aurhora. For more continuous or priority support needs, we offer additional technical support policies and consulting.

aboutUs.heroDescription: At Aurhora Agency, we combine the agility of a young company with the deep experience of a team of professionals who have led the technological vanguard in multiple industries for more than 10 years. We are your strategic partners in managing and integrating solutions that drive real change.
aboutUs.essenceDescription1: Aurhora Agency was born from the conviction that true digital transformation requires more than just technology; it needs vision, expert management and a deep understanding of business. Although we are a recently created agency, our management team and principal consultants accumulate more than 10 years of experience leading complex and successful projects in large corporations and innovative startups.
aboutUs.essenceDescription2: This duality allows us to offer the freshness and adaptability of a new era, backed by the knowledge and solidity of those who have navigated and shaped technological evolution in key sectors.
aboutUs.essenceQuote: "We merge innovative agility with the wisdom of experience."
aboutUs.orchestrationDescription: Our unique capability lies in knowing both large corporations and startups from their roots. This perspective allows us to consolidate multidisciplinary teams of experts who not only understand diverse sectors, but know how to "tropicalize" functionalities, migrating the best from each world to create innovative and tailored solutions for our clients.
aboutUs.expertOrchestrationDesc: We are masters in managing and integrating complex solutions, connecting talent and technology for synergistic and efficient results.
aboutUs.multidisciplinaryTeamsDesc: Our strength lies in the diversity of our experts, coming from multiple sectors, which allows us a 360° vision of each challenge.
aboutUs.tropicalizationInnovationDesc: We adapt and migrate successful functionalities from one sector to another, taking the best from each world to propose fresh and disruptive solutions.
aboutUs.sectorsHeading: Deep expertise in the sectors that demand it most
aboutUs.insuranceDescription1: We have deep knowledge of the Mexican and Latin American insurance industry. We have collaborated with the country's main insurers, developing and integrating technological solutions throughout their value chain.
aboutUs.insuranceDescription2: Our experience spans a wide range of products and business lines, allowing us to offer innovative perspectives and pragmatic solutions that respond to the specific challenges of the sector.
aboutUs.fintechDescription1: The financial sector is constantly evolving, and at Aurhora Agency we are at the forefront. We have worked with traditional banks, disruptive startups and neoBanks, creating from robust mobile banks to agile integration of payment aggregators.
aboutUs.fintechDescription2: We understand the security, regulatory and user experience challenges that define the Fintech sector, and we provide solutions that combine technological innovation with deep knowledge of the financial business.
aboutUs.cocreationTitle: Co-creation: The Pillar of Genuine Solutions
aboutUs.cocreationDescription1: We firmly believe that the most impactful solutions are born from close collaboration. Our co-creation approach means we work hand in hand with you, merging your deep business knowledge with our experience in management, integration and technology.
aboutUs.cocreationDescription2: This collaborative process allows us to go beyond generic solutions, designing and implementing truly personalized strategies and tools that 100% address the unique needs and objectives of your organization, ensuring real and measurable impact.
aboutUs.ctaTitle: Ready for our experience to drive your vision?
